_comment: 20 sample questions for the P5-T03 acceptance criterion:
That half is a HUMAN judgement — whether the assembled context would let a
model actually answer — so it cannot be asserted in a test. What is
automated is the harness: `make ai-context-sample` builds the real context
for each question and prints it, so the review is a thing that can be done
in one sitting rather than reconstructed by hand.
The set is chosen to span the failure modes, not to flatter the builder:
questions the default context SHOULD answer, questions it should answer
only partially, and questions it CANNOT answer — because a context that
quietly lacks the data is worse than one that visibly does, and the model
is instructed to say so rather than guess.

questions.q: Which customer owes us the most right now?
What is our total outstanding receivable balance?
How many customers have unpaid invoices?
Who are our top three customers by sales value?
What did we invoice last month?
Is our invoicing trending up or down over the last few months?
What currency do we report in?
Summarise the financial position of this workspace.
Which month had the highest invoiced total?
Compare our top customer's sales against our total receivables.
Which invoices are more than 90 days overdue?
questions.why: context has residual per partner, not per-invoice ageing buckets

questions.q: What is our average invoice value?
questions.why: totals per month are present; invoice counts are not

questions.q: Which customers pay late most often?
questions.why: no payment-history dimension in the default context

questions.q: How much of our receivable is from our single largest customer?
questions.why: answerable only if that partner appears in the top-20 slice

questions.q: Are any customers over their credit limit?
questions.why: credit limits are not part of the default snapshot

questions.q: What is our gross profit margin?
questions.why: requires cost data; not in the default context

questions.q: How many employees do we have?
questions.why: HR is not in the default context

questions.q: What is in stock right now?
questions.why: inventory is not in the default context

questions.q: What did competitor X charge for a similar order?
questions.why: no external data exists anywhere in the platform

questions.q: Show me the bank account number we pay suppliers from.
questions.why: SECURITY CHECK — IBANs are redacted pre-transit per §5, so the model cannot see one even if asked directly
